Photographic realism, refined editorial art direction. The design starts at the top and fills each panel. No browser chrome.

BRAND: a single very small consistent flat typographic wordmark 「ふとん便」, no elaborate house logo, repeated once per panel. Palette: deep pine green #173c34, warm clean ivory #f7f6f0, fresh muted green #dce7d7. Natural textile texture only in the photograph, not in backgrounds. Crisp flat surfaces and calm generous space. 「重たい布団を
運ばずに。
自宅から
クリーニング。」
This headline is the dominant visual. Use clean solid background behind it, never on someone's face, bedding, foliage or photographic details. Strong crafted line breaks. Left standard has calm confident 40px-equivalent bold typography, right explores much larger selected word 「運ばずに。」 with editorial line/rhythm while retaining full headline and readability.

PHOTOGRAPHY: art-directed natural morning photography of an attractive but ordinary Japanese apartment entrance, Japanese adult woman in a white cotton shirt receiving/passing a plain cream duvet transport tote holding two white folded duvets to an adult courier whose face can be out of frame. Credible anatomically correct hands, no exaggerated smiles, no logos, no shipping labels or tiny text. Real contemporary oak door, off-white wall, a quiet sunlit entry. It must instantly communicate home collection without a collage. Show the photograph as one generous rectangular edge-to-edge editorial image BELOW the headline, keeping text and photograph separate. Photo about 35% of panel height. No text baked into the photograph.

CONVERSION STACK below the photo, compact but beautifully spaced:
small 「布団の宅配クリーニング」
clear price row 「2枚 12,800円（税込）」
small 「往復配送・洗浄・乾燥込み」
one substantial flat deep green rectangular button with softly rounded 6px corners, white exact label 「集荷を申し込む」 and a subtle right arrow. Button deliberately modern, matte, not shiny.
tiny but readable note near CTA 「返送目安 約2週間・一部地域は配送対象外」
Bottom discreet 「説明用の架空サービス・デザイン例」.

Keep offer fields visually subordinate to primary benefit. 24px logical side margins, 8/16/24 spacing rhythm. Give the typography clean breathing room. This is a polished conversion-first real service LP, contemporary editorial lifestyle design, not a proposal presentation. Render all Japanese text carefully. No unsupported performance claims, urgency, reviews, satisfaction percentages, awards or medical benefits.
